speaker: Mr Thomas Chua Kee Seng
text: asked	the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (a) for trade associations which wish to be actively involved to drive the execution of the Industry Transformation Maps, how can they coordinate with the lead Government agencies and be empowered to do so; and (b) for trade associations which want to transform their sectors but do not have an Industry Transformation Map, what specific forms of support can they expect from the Government in the areas of productivity improvement, skills development, innovation and internationalisation.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
text: Industry transformation is a major initiative that requires the commitment of all stakeholders to succeed.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
text: In particular, TACs, with their in-depth understanding of the needs and growth opportunities of their respective industries, can support the development of industry-specific strategies.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
text: Hence, the Industry Transformation Maps (ITMs) are being jointly developed and implemented with industry associations, business chambers, companies as well as unions.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
text: And I think the Member would be familiar with that effort.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
text: The full list of the sectors and the lead agencies is available on the Ministry of Trade and Industry website.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
text: The tripartite partners will be actively involved in all aspects of the ITM process, from planning to implementation.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
text: The 23 sectors include industries which are covered by the National Productivity Council and the SkillsFuture Council and also contribute significantly to the economy and employment.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
text: However, I want to emphasise that our aim is to enhance productivity, innovation and competitiveness across all sectors.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
text: For example, the Singapore Food Manufacturers' Association (SFMA) has helped to develop strategies to drive innovation and exports, which are the industry's priorities.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
text: SFMA, working together with SPRING, implemented design thinking and product development workshops to help food manufacturers develop globally competitive products.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
text: SFMA also worked with IE Singapore to launch an online Singapore shop, "Tasty Singapore", on China's top e-commerce platforms like Alibaba's Tmall, to help local companies enter the Chinese market.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
text: TACs have also helped to generate broad-based support for industry initiatives that require scale beyond the efforts of individual companies.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
text: For instance, the Container Depot Association (Singapore) (or CDAS) recently launched an electronic Container Trucking System, a common information technology platform, which helped shorten waiting time at the depot and reduced redundant trips for all container logistics companies.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
text: Such examples demonstrate the valuable role TACs can play in industry development.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
text: We are still in the early stages and much work remains to be done.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
text: Our TACs are important partners in this effort and can make valuable contributions.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
text: Take it up with the Ministry or economic agency with which you have been dealing.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
text: There are no wrong doors and our economic agencies will do their best to support your efforts with the relevant programme.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
text: We look forward to working closely with our TACs in this important effort.
